stem_text: A block of mass m is kept on a platform which starts from rest with constant acceleration g/2 upward, as shown in figure. Work done by normal reaction on block in time t is - [FIG-stem-1]
figure_reference: [FIG-stem-1] Platform and block setup unverified against authentic master

candidate_solve.derivation: Equation of motion for block in vertical direction: N - mg = m a = m (g/2) => N = mg + mg/2 = (3/2) mg. Upward displacement of platform in time t starting from rest: s = 1/2 a t^2 = 1/2 (g/2) t^2 = (1/4) g t^2. Work done by normal reaction force: W = N * s = ((3/2) mg) * ((1/4) g t^2) = (3 m g^2 t^2) / 8. Matches Option B.
candidate_solve.limiting_cases: If platform had zero acceleration, N = mg and s = 0 (from rest), W = 0. If platform accelerated in free fall (a = -g), N = 0, W = 0. With upward acceleration g/2, N > mg and W > 0.
